_comment: Sprite manifest: maps game entities to sprite-sheet assets under Assets/Sprites/.
Paths are relative to Assets/Sprites/ and are loaded as embedded avares:// resources.
Sheets are horizontal strips; frame size = sheet height, frame count = width / height.
The first pass draws frame 0 only (static); animation can use the rest later.
Lookup order (first hit wins; no hit = the renderer's original procedural shape):
These are editable starter defaults. To use a different sheet from the raw
'Pixel Crawler - *' pack folders, copy it into Assets/Sprites/<category>/ (only the
curated folders ship - see the AvaloniaResource glob in TheMazeRPG.csproj) and point
the key at it here. Unmapped entities keep their old look, so partial maps are fine.
